rules.title: Tenant Screening Fee Limits and Requirements
rules.requirement: The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is $68.96. Landlords must provide a copy of the credit report to the tenant within 7 days, a receipt for the fee, an itemized list of expenses and time spent, and refund any unused portion of the fee. Landlords must use a reusable screening report if provided by the tenant. Screening fees cannot be charged if no rental unit is available, and fees must be returned to applicants not selected unless a policy is in place to review applications in order and only charge the first qualified applicant.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords in Berkeley can charge up to $68.96 for tenant screening in 2026 and must provide a credit report copy, receipt, and refund unused fees. They cannot charge if no unit is available and must return fees to applicants not selected unless following a first-qualified applicant policy.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios en Berkeley pueden cobrar hasta $68.96 por la verificación de inquilinos en 2026 y deben proporcionar una copia del informe crediticio, recibo y reembolsar las tarifas no usadas. No pueden cobrar si no hay unidad disponible y deben devolver las tarifas a los solicitantes no seleccionados a menos que sigan una política de primer solicitante calificado.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental properties in Berkeley.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is $68.96. Landlords may use screening fees to obtain information about a prospective tenant like a consumer credit report. Prospective tenants should expect to receive a copy of their credit report within 7 days of receipt by the landlord, a receipt for the fee paid and an itemized list of any out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord on the screening, and a refund of any unused portion of the fee.

rules.title: Notification of Tenant Screening Fee Rights
rules.requirement: Owners or agents must provide a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and the maximum fee cap permitted under California law before receiving any screening fee.
rules.summary_plain: Before charging a tenant screening fee, landlords in Berkeley must inform applicants of their rights and the maximum fee allowed by law.
rules.summary_plain_es: Antes de cobrar una tarifa de verificación de inquilinos, los propietarios en Berkeley deben informar a los solicitantes sobre sus derechos y la tarifa máxima permitida por la ley.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental properties in Berkeley.
rules.quoted_span: When an owner or the owner’s agent gets a request to rent residential property in Berkeley from an applicant and the owner charges a fee to purchase a consumer credit report and to validate, review, or otherwise process an application, the owner must provide, either in the rental application or in a separate disclosure before receiving the fee, a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and a statement of the maximum fee cap permitted under California Civil Code Section 1950.6(b).

rules.title: Prohibition of Non-Refundable Application Fees for Existing Tenants
rules.requirement: Owners or agents cannot charge a non-refundable fee to existing tenants for renewing a tenancy or for changes related to roommates in a pre-existing household.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords in Berkeley cannot charge existing tenants non-refundable fees for renewing leases or changing roommates.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios en Berkeley no pueden cobrar tarifas no reembolsables a inquilinos existentes por renovar contratos o cambiar compañeros de cuarto.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental agreements in Berkeley.
rules.quoted_span: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.
